sample_unit: human-generated counseling conversations (15,680 turns; 42,230 LLM responses; 5,324 reviewer judgments)

links.outcome: Atrophy-aligned behaviour (directive advice, validation reinforcing dependence) in LLM mental-health counseling responses
links.effect: Five LLMs showed a consistent moderate-to-high level of atrophy-aligned behaviour across single and multi-turn settings; dominant patterns were directive advice, problem-solving, recommendations, topic shifts and dependence-reinforcing validation.
links.quote: Across five LLMs, models show a consistent moderate-to-high level of atrophy-aligned behaviour across single and multi-turn settings.

unlisted_practices: Measuring process-level cognitive atrophy (reflection-preserving vs dependence-reinforcing behaviour) of LLMs in mental-health support using clinician-annotated risk indices (UIRI, ARI)

screen.reason: The study develops and applies a benchmark and evaluation framework (COGNITIVE ATROPHY BENCH) to assess LLM behaviors (such as fostering cognitive dependence vs. self-reflection) in mental health counseling conversations.
